slides.title: Alignment does not come from a title.
slides.sub: Three moves I use when I own the outcome, not the people.

paras: I have led teams of up to 10 across design, content and product and aligned stakeholders across 100+ markets.
None of it came with formal line authority. What worked was making decisions easier to agree on, not arguing louder.
slides.title: What moves people without authority?
Three moves
items: Name the decision and its owner before anyone discusses solutions.
Show what each option costs each stakeholder, in their terms.
Write down what you said no to, and why.

slides.title: Push versus pull
slides.before: Escalate, convince, repeat the same slide in every meeting.
slides.after: One named decision, visible trade-offs, a written record of the no.
slides.punch: People defend what they helped decide.

slides.title: Own the decision, not the people.
slides.sub: In banking, health and energy, alignment is a risk control, not a soft skill.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
